note: Every historical Genesis free claim of Forgive & Forget token 1. wallet, claimContract and transactionHash are verified on-chain by the snapshot generator (GenesisHolderClaimed event in the receipt). usedTokenId is the Genesis unit each claim consumed, from the REDEEMED rows of genesis_claim_reservations in the mainnet database (read 2026-10-31); it is off-chain accounting and is checked only by requiring that the claimant still holds that token id.
